title: Lunden glTF node extras (#2245)
description: The `extras` object of every node in an exported zone GLB (three.js GLTFExporter writes Object3D.userData there). Node names equal `id`. Ids are built from kind, level and the object's position in centimetres (doors: the hinge; furniture: the piece's centre), so they stay the same between exports and across unrelated changes; a duplicate gets _2, _3 … in scene order. Unreal keeps them as actor tags / asset metadata so Blueprints and the measurement data can find the object.

id.description: letters, digits, _ and - only (Unreal object names cannot hold dots); a part is <parent id>__<n>

kind.description: zone = the GLB's root; wall = a plan wall polygon extruded floor → ceiling; structure = other static building geometry (floors, ceilings, frames, stair, fittings); door / window = an opening leaf or sash (moves); furniture = a FURNITURE piece, or a furnishing main.js builds (the fruit bowl, the basketball holder and the ball, #2310); interactive = another openable (cabinet door, drawer, appliance lid); light = a lamp or ceiling fixture; collision = a simple box (never rendered); fixture = an axis/position test marker; part = a child of one of these

level.description: 0 = Entréplan, 1 = Övre plan (by the node's lowest point)

source.description: where the object comes from: a JSON pointer into data/plan.json, src/config.js#NAME[i], or a world.* list; null when no single source exists

name.description: the web's Swedish display name (E prompt), if any

webId.description: the web's own id (furniture: the saved-layout id from src/furniture.js `movable`)

materialKeys.description: material keys used under this node (measurements.json `materials`)

parent.description: part: the id of the object it belongs to

box.description: collision: the box in web metres

direction.description: fixture arrow: unit direction in web axes

castShadow.description: the web mesh casts no sun shadow (three.js castShadow false); absent = it casts. Unreal turns the component's Cast Shadow off (#2426)

patioStringBulb.description: Fence bulb using the shared unlit material driven by the patio dusk light.

seasonal.description: shown only in a season ([month, day], inclusive; src/christmas.js)
